text: ポケモンの　わざで　もぐれるかも？

structure.jp: ポケモンの　わざで

patterns.name: 〜かもしれない
patterns.explanation: かも is the short form of かもしれない, 'maybe'. もぐれるかも = 'maybe you can dive'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing もぐる 'dive under' to もぐれる gives the meaning 'can dive under'. もぐれる = 'can dive'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing shows the tool or means used to do something. ポケモンの　わざで = 'with a Pokémon's move'.
